facts.fact: Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is a 1996 graphic adventure game.
facts.supporting_span: Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is a 1996 graphic adventure game

facts.fact: Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was developed by Zombie LLC.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was published by Activision.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is the eleventh game in the Zork series.
facts.supporting_span: It is the eleventh game in the Zork series

facts.fact: Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is the first title in the Zork series not to appear under the Infocom label.
facts.supporting_span: It is the eleventh game in the Zork series , and the first such title not to appear under the Infocom label .

facts.fact: Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands features a darker, less comical story within the Zork setting.
facts.supporting_span: It features a darker , less comical story within the Zork setting .

facts.fact: The story of Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands focuses on players investigating the sudden disappearance of four prominent figures and their children.
